name: Felix Industries Ltd.
summary: Felix Industries Ltd. specializes in comprehensive environmental solutions, with a primary focus on water management. The company's operations are distinctly structured into three core divisions: Water and Wastewater Management, Solid Waste Management, and Hydrocarbon Recycling. The Water and Wastewater Management division delivers holistic, end-to-end services aimed at recovering, purifying, and facilitating the sustainable reuse of water for both industrial and municipal applications. Within Solid Waste Management, the company concentrates on the secure handling, efficient processing, and extraction of valuable resources from municipal and industrial waste streams, including the conversion of waste into energy. Lastly, the Hydrocarbon Recycling division is dedicated to reclaiming valuable hydrocarbons and their derivatives from oily and hazardous industrial byproducts. This not only significantly reduces ecological risks but also actively promotes resource recirculation. Founded in 2010 by Ritesh Vinay Patel, Felix Industries Ltd. is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
